description: An official side event of TOKEN2049 Singapore, co-hosted by Global Fintech Institute and Grayscale. About Event Financial privacy and regulatory accountability are often treated as competing demands. But can both exist within the same system? This private discussion brings together perspectives from the Zcash ecosystem, institutional investors, regulators, academics and digital asset practitioners to examine where the regulatory perimeter sits, and what it means for privacy, proof, allocation, custody and compliance. As privacy preserving cryptography moves from theory into audited and deployed infrastructure, the conversation is shifting from whether privacy can coexist with supervision to how privacy and accountability can be engineered together. Join us for a focused conversation and meaningful connections during TOKEN2049 Singapore. ✦ WHY ATTEND? Join us to: Explore how financial privacy and regulatory accountability can coexist within the same system Understand the tension between supervisory traceability and client confidentiality Examine what privacy preserving infrastructure means for institutional allocation, custody and compliance Hear perspectives from the Zcash ecosystem on the practical deployment of privacy technology Consider how regulators and institutions across Asia can approach oversight of privacy preserving digital assets Connect with leaders across finance, regulation, academia and digital assets in an intimate setting Whether you are a regulator, institutional investor, academic or digital asset professional, join the conversation on how financial privacy can work in institutional practice. ✦ EVENT AGENDA 2:30 PM | Registration & Welcome 3:00 PM | Opening RemarksGrayscale × Global Fintech Institute 3:10 PM | Panel Discussion 4:00 PM | Refreshments & Networking 6:00 PM | Event Concludes All times are in Singapore Time (SGT). ✦ SPEAKERS Zooko Wilcox-O’Hearn is the founder of Zcash and a long-time contributor to privacy-preserving digital money,

description: Risky Business: Singapore A curated afternoon for the teams with TVL onchain and the investors allocating capital into them. Risk in crypto is compounding faster than most teams are accounting for. Protocols build on protocols. Vaults stack strategies across lending markets, oracles, and bridges they don't fully control. Every integration adds a dependency, and every dependency is a surface that can break. Growth is great, but it can change your risk profile without warning.At the same time, AI-assisted attacks have made 2026 the most-hacked year in history, with $1.3 billion lost in the first half alone.The people managing this risk and the people pricing it need deeper and more honest conversations. That's what this event is for. Who is in the Room DeFi protocol teams Vault providers Strategy builders Risk curators Investors and allocators If you're here, it's because you have something at stake and you want to keep it safe. Format Drinks and conversation. This is a curated space designed to deepen risk understanding and build valuable relationships. Refreshments will be available until supply lasts. Hosted by Grego AI Grego AI's security harness finds critical vulnerabilities in your code and makes it easy for you to fix them. Our AI is ranked #1 on Immunefi and HackenProof, with almost $1M in verified bug bounties. Our security engagements are human-led and AI-scaled.

description: As digital assets move from the margins into core financial infrastructure, financial crime risk (FCR) teams face a widening set of challenges—from divergent regulatory expectations to the operational realities of scaling compliance across new product lines. Join our panel during TOKEN2049 Week in Singapore as senior voices from legal, compliance, and industry unpack how financial institutions and digital asset firms are adapting their financial crime programs for this evolving landscape. The conversation will cover: How financial crime operations differ between digital assets and traditional finance, and where those lines are blurring The evolving path to securing and managing US licensing applications Structuring reliance arrangements with parent companies or broker-dealer partners Operating crypto within a multi-product financial institution FCR's expanding remit as products diversify — from prediction markets and perpetuals to retail and stablecoin offerings Striking the right balance between rigorous onboarding controls and a seamless client experience Moderator:Anir Bhattacharyya, Partner, AlixPartners Speakers:Ali Burney, Partner, SteptoeAnna Gates, Senior Advisor, AlixPartnersPeter Woo, Director - Crypto Compliance, Moomoo CryptoBrandon O'Shea, Director - FCSO Digital Asset Investigations, Standard Chartered

name: The Real Yield Happy Hour by HoneyB
description: For much of DeFi’s history, “yield” was fueled by token incentives, emissions, and liquidity mining. High APYs attracted capital, but too often the yield disappeared when the incentives stopped. That is changing. Credit, equities, Treasuries, ETFs, and institutional income strategies are moving onchain, bringing yield generated by real economic activity into DeFi. Interest paid by borrowers. Dividends from companies. Income from public markets. Cash flows that exist beyond token incentives. As TradFi and DeFi converge, onchain yield is evolving from something created for crypto into a new distribution layer for the world's income-producing assets. As the saying goes: "If you don’t know where the yield is coming from, you are the yield.” Join HoneyB for drinks and a conversation about the next generation of real yield and onchain capital markets.

description: Quantum Security for Digital Assets This private technical networking event brings together industry leaders, protocol engineers, cryptography researchers, digital asset specialists and institutional stakeholders to examine the emerging security requirements of digital assets in a post quantum environment. The discussion will focus on the cryptographic foundations required to protect digital asset infrastructure as quantum computing develops, including digital signatures, transaction authentication, identity, key management, consensus security and the protection of blockchain execution environments. Panels with industry leaders will be followed by relaxed networking with senior peers over food and drinks. Particular attention will be given to the transition from conventional elliptic curve cryptography toward post quantum cryptographic systems and the practical considerations involved in implementing these mechanisms at protocol level. Topics will include Post quantum digital signatures and transaction authentication Quantum resistant identity and account structures Key generation, address derivation and key lifecycle management Post quantum consensus and validator communication Cryptographic verification within distributed systems Quantum resistant smart contract infrastructure Migration considerations for existing digital asset systems Security implications for institutional digital asset custody and infrastructure. The discussion will also examine how post quantum cryptography can be integrated throughout a blockchain protocol rather than being implemented as an isolated security layer. Quantova will present its approach to post quantum blockchain architecture, including the Quantova Virtual Machine and its implementation of PQR cryptographic primitives across transaction signing, account creation, consensus and execution. description: The Corridor: Asia & Europe Two Regimes, One Rail. (Singapore ⇆ Vienna as the execution examples.) For the first time both ends of the corridor are writing the same rulebook at the same time. MiCAR is fully in force across the EU. In Singapore, MAS has its draft stablecoin law out for consultation until 16 October, nine days after this evening. Both ask for full reserves, redemption at par and orderly wind-down. Neither answers the practical question for a bank, a payment institution or an exchange: who moves money between the two regimes, at what cost, and what still breaks in the middle. Singapore and Vienna are where this evening takes its examples from, because each is the entry seat for the other side. The corridor itself runs the full width of Asia and Europe. Hosted by Advantage Austria, the event will be proudly sponsored by LDC EU, Black Manta Capital, Taxbit, EY Law, Bluecode, Talos and Digital Asset Association Austria. description: Event Overview With AI systems becoming more capable and autonomous, the prospect of advanced AI causing human extinction makes understanding their behaviour one of the most consequential research challenges of our time. Can a virtual world help us test their moral boundaries before real-world failures do? Following the May 2026 announcement of Google DeepMind taking a minority equity stake in Fenris Creations and entering into a research partnership, the two teams have been exploring the EVE Universe as a testing ground for advanced AI. The work spans EVE Online and EVE Frontier, investigating how autonomous agents choose to behave in a persistent world of shifting alliances, competing interests and complex moral choices. Will an AI honour an agreement when resources run scarce? Resist manipulation? Recognise when an action is possible, but wrong? Join us in a private penthouse suite during Singapore’s TOKEN2049 week for an invitation-only conversation with the people driving this research, alongside a small group of investors, policymakers, researchers and industry leaders. Explore the research with Google DeepMind Speakers Hilmar Veigar Pétursson — CEO, Fenris CreationsLeading the studio since 2004, Hilmar has helped pioneer the player-driven economies and persistent societies that make EVE a compelling environment for AI research. description: Agents are starting to earn, spend, and settle on-chain, but their money still crosses chains like it's 2021. About Pharos Network Pharos is the inclusive financial Layer 1 for RealFi, where real value and institutional-grade assets circulate onchain and become composable with decentralized assets. By bringing together scalable blockchain infrastructure, tokenized assets, sustainable yield, and AI-powered financial experiences, Pharos is building a more open and accessible foundation for global finance.About DIADIA is a trustless oracle network. Its modular, rollup-based design enables verifiable sourcing and delivery of any data to any blockchain. The network is permissionless, allowing anyone to deploy oracles, operate nodes, and participate as stakers in the distributed data sourcing process. Unlike traditional oracles that rely on opaque third-party data, DIA sources first-party data directly from any source. This enables 100% transparency and customization while supporting any data type. DIA's native Layer-2, Lasernet, executes all critical oracle operations. Oracles are computed onchain, providing unmatched trustless execution and full verifiability, secured by both crypto-economic and cryptographic mechanisms.

description: AI & Formal Verification for Onchain Finance Defending DeFi, stablecoins and RWAs in the age of AI-powered attacks. A focused, invite-only gathering for the researchers, founders, and protocol teams shaping the next era of onchain finance, at a moment when attackers have started turning to AI and defense must move from "tested" to "proven." This session examines a shift already underway. As stablecoins mature into payment rails and RWAs bring real-world value onchain, the value at stake has surged, while AI is making attacks faster, cheaper, and harder to anticipate. Drawing on real exploit investigations and deep security experience across DeFi, stablecoin, and RWA protocols, the conversation centers on what provable security actually looks like when the threat itself becomes intelligent. Rather than a one-way panel, this is built for genuine exchange among people solving the same problems. Discussions are structured, candid, and grounded in real systems, giving technical and business leaders room to challenge assumptions, compare defensive approaches, and engage directly with leading researchers and peers navigating the same frontier. What to Expect Honest discussion on how AI is reshaping both attack and defence across onchain finance. Deep dives into recent exploits, failure modes, and the patterns behind them. A practical look at formal verification, and why provable security is becoming the standard for stablecoins, RWAs, and institutional-grade protocols. Who Should Attend Founders • CTOs • Stablecoin & RWA Teams • Protocol Architects • Security Researchers • Auditors • Institutional & DeFi Builders 📆 Location: Singapore (private venue shared with approved attendees) Each invitation is personally confirmed. Seats are extremely limited, and you must confirm.

description: 21 seats. One table. No panel, no pitch deck. The Institutional Table is a private, invite-only dinner hosted by QuillAudits on the closing night of Token2049 Singapore. Banks, asset managers, funds, exchanges, custodians, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned. What we will talk about Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or money market structure moves on-chain. ERC-3643, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them. Lessons from Project Guardian pilots going to production. Stablecoins as payment rails: MAS-regulated issuance, reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and where issuers have been exploited. The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management, incident response. What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walk through the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what each one should have caught earlier. Format Seated dinner for 21. Short opening from QuillAudits, then moderated conversation under Chatham House rules. No recording, no press, no slides. Who is at the table Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation. Seats are confirmed personally. Registering here is a request, not a confirmation. Venue in the Marina Bay area, shared with confirmed guests. About QuillAudits 8+ years securing Web3. 1,500+ audits, 1M+ lines reviewed. 20+ RWA and tokenization protocols audited.
